correctness.rationale: The degree-n monomial row of R_r:H2(D^d)->A_d sends z^nu to r^nu z^n, while ||z^n||^2=1/binom(n+d-1,d-1); orthogonal homogeneous blocks are rank-one, giving sigma_n^2=h_n(u)/N_n exactly. Dirichlet(1,...,1)-mixture of iid category draws makes composition counts uniform, so sigma_n^2=E prod u_j^A_{n,j} decreases with n. Factoring prod(1-u_j z)^-1 at the maximal poles gives k unit-radius polynomial asymptotic and k=0 exponential decay, hence contact-count Schatten cutoff and k=d coisometry. For scaling radii exp(-t_j/2N), conditional multinomial expectation of exp(-sample-average(t)) compared with exp(-Dirichlet mean) yields nonnegative Jensen gap <= E Var(t|P)/(2N)=sum(t_j-tbar)^2/(2N(d+1)). Uniform log-sum-exp expansion gives +(2N)^-1 E[e^-mu Var(t|P)] plus O(N^-2) on compact t sets. Checked exact rational h_n(u)/N_n for u=(1,1/4,0), degrees 1,2,3,15 independently. Finite checks do not establish asymptotics.
